_comment: Text condition only. Plain-language descriptions of each clip, matched to the stills used in the frames condition. Kept factual: what moves, how far, how long, and how the timing feels, with no words that hint at a gesture.
p-translate: A blue rounded square sits on the left of a white area. Over about 1.2 seconds it slides horizontally to the right, roughly three times its own width. It eases away from rest, moves fastest in the middle, and eases to a stop. Nothing else changes.
p-scale: A blue circle sits in the middle of a white area. Over about 0.9 seconds it grows to roughly two and a half times its size, staying centred. Most of the growth happens early; it slows as it reaches full size and stops there.
p-rotate: A blue rounded square sits in the middle of a white area, with a small white dot near one corner marking its orientation. Over about 1.4 seconds it turns half a full turn in place. It eases into the turn, is fastest in the middle, and eases to a stop.
p-fade: A blue rounded square in the middle of a white area is invisible at first. Over about 1.2 seconds it becomes fully visible, at a steady rate with no speeding up or slowing down. It does not move or change size.
p-bounce: A blue circle starts near the top of a white area, above a thin horizontal line. It falls, speeding up as it drops, and hits the line after about 0.7 seconds. It rebounds to about half the height it fell from, falls again, and bounces twice more, each bounce lower and quicker, until it comes to rest on the line. The whole thing takes about 1.7 seconds.
p-overshoot: A blue rounded square on the left of a white area moves quickly to the right, about three times its own width. It goes slightly past where it settles, comes back a little too far, and wobbles with two or three smaller corrections that get rapidly smaller until it rests. The whole thing takes about 1.4 seconds.
p-compound: A blue rounded square starts low on the left of a white area. Over about 1.6 seconds it travels diagonally up and to the right while at the same time turning half a full turn and growing to about one and a half times its size. All three changes start and finish together, easing in and easing out.
p-arc: A blue circle starts low on the left of a white area, on a thin horizontal line. Over about 1.4 seconds it travels to the right at a constant sideways rate while rising and then falling, tracing a smooth arch like a thrown ball. It is highest in the middle of the journey, and lands back on the line at the right.
p-shake: A blue circle in the middle of a white area jolts sideways. It swings left and right about seven times in roughly 0.8 seconds, each swing smaller than the last, and ends where it started.
u-toggle: A grey pill-shaped switch with a white circular knob at its left end. Over about 0.4 seconds the knob slides to the right end of the pill, slightly overshooting before settling, while the pill's colour changes from grey to green.
u-modal: A phone screen shows a list of rows. The screen behind darkens over about 0.25 seconds. At the same time a white dialog box appears in the upper middle of the screen, starting small and see-through and growing to full size over about 0.45 seconds, slightly overshooting its final size before settling.
u-sheet: A phone screen shows a list of rows. The screen darkens, and a white panel slides up from the bottom edge until it covers the lower half of the screen. It moves fastest as it starts and eases to a stop. It takes about 0.6 seconds.
u-card-expand: A phone screen shows four small cards in a grid. Over about 0.65 seconds the bottom-right card grows and moves until it fills the entire screen, its corners straightening as it goes, with its image area growing along with it. Once it has nearly finished, several lines of text fade in and drift up slightly inside it.
u-list-stagger: A phone screen with an empty list. Seven rows appear one after another from top to bottom. Each row fades in while sliding up a short distance, taking about 0.4 seconds, and each starts shortly after the one above it, so the whole list fills in over about 0.9 seconds.
u-toast: A phone screen shows a list. A white notification bar drops in from above the top edge, overshooting slightly before settling just below the top. It stays still for about 1.5 seconds, then slides back up out of view, speeding up as it leaves. The whole thing takes about 2.6 seconds.
u-like: A grey heart in the middle of a white area. It shrinks slightly, then springs up larger than its original size while turning pink-red, then settles back to its normal size, over about 0.6 seconds. As it springs out, a ring expands outward from it and fades, and eight small dots shoot outward in all directions, shrinking as they go.
u-tabs: A row of three labels, Photos, Albums and People, with a short underline beneath the first. Over about 0.6 seconds the underline travels to the third label. It stretches out as it leaves, spanning the full width mid-journey, then contracts back to a short underline under the third label. At the same time the content below slides sideways by two panels, and the highlighted label changes from the first to the third.
u-error-shake: A login form with two fields and a dark button. The button dips slightly, as if pressed, and returns. A moment later the second field's outline turns red and the whole form jolts left and right about seven times over half a second, each swing smaller than the last, and a short red message appears beneath the field.
u-submit-morph: A wide blue button reading Submit sits in the middle of a white area. Its label fades out while the button shrinks from the sides into a small blue circle, taking about 0.35 seconds. A white ring then spins inside the circle for about 1.2 seconds. The spinner fades out, the circle turns green, and a white checkmark springs up to full size inside it. The whole thing takes about 2 seconds.
